next_action.why: 没有已承诺的融资能恢复安全线；这是保持在零以上最便宜的方式。
next_action.detail: Projected cash closes at ¥44,986.20 today, ¥255,013.80 below the reserve floor; the gap peaks at ¥455,013.80 in 8 days and lasts until 42 days from now. No committed plan restores the reserve; the cure that keeps cash at or above zero is: finance an invoice on Invoice financing (onboarded platform) ¥155,013.80, cost ¥1,381.32 (32.5% a year for 10 days); that is above the 15.00% limit you signed for funding without your approval, so it needs your approval before it runs. It does not restore the reserve: cash stays at or above zero, but the reserve is still ¥300,000.00 short at the worst day, which needs the owner's decision. The projection lets cash run below zero only as a simulation limit; the bank does not allow an overdraft, so a negative figure is a day the books cannot pay what falls due.
